<issue>
MSDF font atlases are mipmapped, corrupting the median on minified text
### Summary

MSDF font atlas textures are loaded with mipmaps enabled (`mipmaps: true`, `minFilter: FILTER_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR`). Mipmapping is wrong for MSDF: each mip level box-averages the R/G/B channels, but `median(average) != average(median)`, so under minification the shader samples a corrupted median. This shows as faint ghost/flicker artifacts on small text — e.g. a thin horizontal line that flickers on and off just below closely-spaced stems (the `ll` in "Hello") as the text moves. Most visible at small `fontSize` and DPR 1 / non-HiDPI.

### Why it's visible now

Latent for a long time (the atlas has always been mipmapped), but surfaced by #8990, which renders MSDF text at the true glyph edge (threshold `0.5`). The previous inward erosion (~`0.525` plus the `(m-0.05)/0.95` remap) had kept the faint corrupted-median values below the render threshold. Related to #8984.

### Repro

- MSDF font (e.g. store Roboto), `ElementComponent` text, small `fontSize` (~6), `useDevicePixelRatio: false` (DPR 1 makes it much easier to see), text translating sub-pixel.
- A faint horizontal line flickers below the `ll`. Forcing the atlas to sample the base level only (no mipmaps) eliminates it, without making small text look worse.

### Fix direction / constraints

Load MSDF atlases at the base level only — `mipmaps: false` + `minFilter: FILTER_LINEAR` (bitmap fonts should keep their mipmaps). Two things make this non-trivial:

1. **Must be set at texture *creation*, not mutated after load.** On WebGPU `Texture#mipmaps` can't be changed after creation (the setter warns and keeps the mip chain), and the WebGPU sampler sets no `lodMaxClamp`, so even a non-mip `minFilter` still minifies into the chain — the artifact persists unless the mip chain doesn't exist.
2. **No clean creation-options channel.** Font atlas textures load via `loader.load(url, 'texture', cb)` with no asset, so there's currently no tidy way to pass creation options (mipmaps/minFilter) through to the texture handler. #8996 attempted to add one by threading an `options` arg through `ResourceHandler.open` but that was rejected (too broad / public-API surface). The clean channel is the open design question.

Closed attempt: #8996.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (PlayCanvas engine), find where font atlas textures are loaded (src/framework/handlers/font.js, and the texture handler src/framework/handlers/texture.js, and loader.js load()). Report the full relevant code of font.js load/_loadTextures and texture.js load/open (how it creates Texture with mipmaps/minFilter, and how it uses asset), with line numbers. Also report if the font json has a 'type' field ('msdf') available at texture load time.

content.content: {"summary":"Font atlas PNGs are loaded by FontHandler._loadTextures, which calls loader.load(url,'texture') without an asset argument. TextureHandler.open therefore receives asset=undefined, so no minFilter, mipmaps or other asset options are applied to font atlases. The font JSON 'type' field is read only in the Font constructor and never reaches the texture load path.","findings":["src/framework/handlers/font.js:54-94 FontHandler.load: a .json URL is fetched with http.get, upgraded via upgradeDataSchema, and _loadTextures(url.load.replace('.json','.png'), data, cb) is called. Otherwise (lines 89-92) asset.data is upgraded and _loadTextures(url.load, asset && asset.data, callback) is called.","src/framework/handlers/font.js:96-132 _loadTextures: numTextures = data.info.maps.length (line 97). For each index it calls loader.load(url,'texture',onLoaded) for index 0, or the url with '.png' replaced by `${index}.png` (lines 122-126). onLoaded calls texture.upload() (line 114) and calls back once all maps are loaded (lines 117-119). No asset is passed and no mipmap or minFilter options are set.","src/framework/handlers/font.js:134-149 FontHandler.open: new Font(data.textures, data.data) when textures exist, else new Font(data, null); sets font._loader.","src/framework/handlers/loader.js:118-177 ResourceLoader.load(url,type,callback,asset,options): looks up the handler by type, caches by makeKey(url,type), and calls handler.load(urlObj,...). The asset argument is used only for DataView/blob URL bookkeeping (lines 52-57).","src/framework/handlers/texture.js:154-214 _getTextureOptions(asset): always returns {profilerHint}. It adds name, minFilter, magFilter, addressU/V, mipmaps, anisotropy, flipY, srgb and type only when asset is truthy and asset.data has those keys (lines 162-210). With asset undefined, as in font loading, only the profiler hint is returned.","src/framework/handlers/texture.js:216-252 TextureHandler.open(url,data,asset): selects a parser (line 224), calls parser.open(url,data,this._device,textureOptions) (line 232), and falls back to a 4x4 RGB8 Texture if the result is null (lines 234-239). Otherwise it runs _completePartialMipmapChain (line 243) and clears a basis GGGR flag if data.unswizzledGGGR is set (lines 246-248). Mip and minFilter defaults come from the parser or Texture constructor, not from this handler.","src/framework/handlers/texture.js:37-44 JSON_TEXTURE_TYPE map. Line 51 begins _completePartialMipmapChain, which resamples RGBA8/RGBA32F partial mip chains up to the full count (lines 51-113). It does not set filters.","No literal 'msdf' string appears in font.js, texture.js or loader.js. The font type is read at src/framework/font/font.js:21 as `this.type = data ? data.type || FONT_MSDF : FONT_MSDF;`, so a JSON 'type' field is available at font construction time (after textures load), defaulting to msdf when absent. It is not available to the texture handler at texture load time, because _loadTextures passes only the URL and the 'texture' type."],"confidence":0.85}

input.instruction: In /testbed/src/framework/handlers/texture.js, show _makeContext and any use of `asset` in parsers/ (src/framework/parsers/texture/*.js) and handler.js, to determine whether a fake asset {data:{mipmaps:false,minfilter:'linear'}} (no file, no name) would crash. Also show JSON_FILTER_MODE.

content.content: {"summary":"No crash on the texture-option and parser-selection path for the fake asset, which has no file and no name. It does crash in the img parser's progress reporting, because that calls `asset?.fire(...)` on a plain object with no `fire` method. The `open()` path also needs a truthy url.","findings":["texture.js:217-231 `_makeContext`/`_getTextureOptions`: `asset.name?.length` and `asset.file && ...` are guarded, and `asset.data` is read directly, so `{data:{mipmaps:false,minfilter:'linear'}}` is safe here. Output is minFilter=FILTER_LINEAR, mipmaps=false, type=TEXTURETYPE_DEFAULT.","handler.js:217-227 `_makeContext` only passes `asset` through into the context and never dereferences it.","texture.js:204 `open()` returns undefined early if `!url`, so a url must be supplied. texture.js:246 `asset.file.variants` is only reached when `data.unswizzledGGGR` is set, which the fake asset does not trigger.","img.js:109 and :113 call `asset?.fire('progress', ...)`. The `?.` only guards a null asset, so with a plain object this throws TypeError (fire is undefined). This happens on the `_loadImage` path (img.js:71), which is taken when `device.supportsImageBitmap` is false.","img.js:149 passes `progress: asset` to http.get. src/platform/net/http.js:188-192 calls `progress.fire(...)` on progress events, so a fake asset without `fire` would also throw there on the ImageBitmap path.","basis.js:35 and ktx2.js:138 use `asset.name` and `asset.getFileUrl()` in an error message. These only run on the missing-Basis-module path, and `getFileUrl` does not exist on the fake asset, so that path would throw too.","hdr.js:28 `asset.data && ...` and img.js:40/62 (`asset?.file?.contents`, `asset.options`) are safe with the fake asset.","asset.js:637 `fetchArrayBuffer` uses `asset?.file?.contents`, which is safe, so fetching is fine.","JSON_FILTER_MODE is defined twice with identical content: texture.js:28-35 (nearest→FILTER_NEAREST, linear→FILTER_LINEAR, nearest_mip_nearest, linear_mip_nearest, nearest_mip_linear, linear_mip_linear) and texture-atlas.js:23-30. texture.js:170 and :174 use it. Unknown keys yield undefined."],"confidence":0.7}
